dedupe_keys.name: cnig download centre centro de descargas of the national geographic institute of spain

description: The CNIG Download Centre is the platform of the National Geographic Institute of Spain and the National Centre for Geographic Information that makes Spain's geographic information available to the public, searching among more than two million resources. Its catalogue covers national topographic maps (such as MTN25 and MTN50 raster and vector), provincial and regional maps, topographic and cartographic databases such as the Base Topográfica Nacional (BTN), a three-dimensional multiscale database at 1:2,000 to 1:25,000 with complete coverage of Spain, reference and thematic geographic information, digital elevation models (for example MDT02 and MDT05), aerial and satellite imagery including the latest PNOA orthophotos, LiDAR point clouds (second coverage 2015 to 2021 and third coverage 2022 to 2025), and historical cartography, with web services for integration in other applications and links to the Hydrographic Institute's bathymetry. Download is free with attribution of the source and ownership of the data, under the CC BY 4.0 licence, and users can create an account. Caveats: the catalogue is mainly in Spanish, and products differ in date and coverage. Coverage is Spain. It supports hazard exposure analysis and network modelling, such as flood and landslide mapping with LiDAR terrain models and locating roads, rail and buildings from the BTN; related records are ESA WorldCover and the swisstopo building models catalogued by another piece.
